the CEO will give a talk next week. --> a future plan
the CEO is giving a talk next week. --> a personal future plan
The CEO is going to give a talk next week. --> ontends or want give talk
The CEO gives talk next week. --> a official timetable and CEO gives talk every week.

we often use will to state what we expect or know will happen in future.
we use the present continuous when we talk about personal arrangment.
we usually use present simple for official timatable and schedules. like simple present future. 
the train leaves at 8. --> every day at 8 train leaves.
